During their three-day summit, President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping agreed to form a "U.S.-China Super Intelligence Dialogue" to discuss the risks and benefits of artificial intelligence.
Super intelligence is Trump's preferred term for AI, and the two leaders consented to use the moniker instead of artificial intelligence.
The White House said that the next discussion will take place by November. The two also decided to create a bilateral communication channel for SI incidents.

title: Trump, Xi agree to 'super intelligence' discussions amid AI concerns
